section.collisionDescription: Builds simplified collision from DAE/FBX geometry (skin-baked when rigged), then converts to HKT via Havok Content Tools.
section.simplificationDescription: Shape-preserving keeps the source surface; High 32k is the current single-shape detail budget for HKT generation. Convex outline builds a coarse outer shell for low-poly bounds.

fields.realQuadsHint: Merge valid triangle pairs into authored quad primitives; disable for triangle-only diagnostics.

none.label: Full surface
none.hint: Export every render triangle as collision

medium.label: Merge flats
medium.hint: Merge coplanar faces on flats and panels (recommended)

high.label: High 32k
high.hint: Detailed single-shape collision budget for the current encoder

heavy.label: Low 5%
heavy.hint: Aggressive merge and curved-surface decimation for low-poly collision

generateFromModel.title: Generate HKT from New Model
generateFromModel.subtitle: Replace collision for {{name}}
generateFromModel.footerHint: Preview is optional and caches the HKT. Generate & Replace uses the cache when available, otherwise generates fresh collision data.
generateFromModel.intro: Read a fresh DAE or FBX, rebuild a Havok collision shape, and replace the collision for {{name}}. Generate & Replace uses the previewed HKT when one exists; otherwise it generates fresh collision data and writes map_hit.hkt into the open stage folder when one is loaded.
generateFromModel.overwriteHint: Its current collision is overwritten when you apply.
generateFromModel.geometryOnly: Only the geometry is read. The model is converted straight to collision; nothing else is imported.
generateFromModel.decodeUnavailable: Havok SDK XML decode unavailable. Preview shows the HKT input mesh instead of decoded HKT.
generateFromModel.cachedHint: HKT is cached in memory; Generate & Replace will apply this preview.
